productIdentity.name: MOT Groove Ultra — Gambit / Knight custom appearance
productIdentity.evidenceBoundary: User imagery controls the custom appearance. Exact-product public sources control only published envelope, mass, motion family, removable rear patch and visible teardown topology.

publishedEnvelope.status: same-model published specification; not a user measurement

mechanism.primary: straight push along the long axis
mechanism.secondary: rotation through a mechanical linkage track
mechanism.magnetRole: removable decorative patch retention only; not motion drive

appearance.body: near-black polished purple-gray metal with a narrow local spectral edge highlight
appearance.frontUpper: mother-of-pearl chess cells, coral-red knight and MORE THAN CLASSIC plaque below a clear cap
appearance.frontLowerExposed: separate mother-of-pearl cells and round MOT crest revealed by the push
appearance.back: KNIGHT IN CHESS circular knight medallion, twin chess-cell rails and MOT STUDIO spine
appearance.emission: in darkness only cyan/blue chess cells and the orange knight emit; metal, plaques and text remain non-emissive

modelingDecision.classificationCaveat: Workbench compatibility name only; the true motion drive is mechanical.
modelingDecision.digitalReconstructionPolicy: Published outer dimensions are fixed. Hidden dimensions derived from same-product teardown imagery remain hash-linked, provisional, reversible and non-manufacturing.
